findings.description: Matěj Janovský and a wife named Marie had a son Josef, born 25 January 1874 and baptised 26 January 1874 at Malšice, Tábor, Bohemia; the baptism index names the father Matěj Janovský and gives the mother only as Marie, with no surname.
supporting_sources: Czech Republic, Church Books, 1552-1981 — Malšice baptism register 1861-1887, entry for Josef Janovsky, born 25 Jan 1874, baptised 26 Jan 1874, father Matěj Janovský, mother Marie

findings.description: A woman named Marie was the wife of Matěj Janovský by January 1874, as mother of his son Josef. The tree's only wife for him is Kateřina Votýpková, married 1866, so this is a second wife or an error in the index.

person.name: Marie
person.role: named as the mother on the 26 January 1874 Malšice baptism of Josef, son of Matěj Janovský

supporting_sources: Czech Republic, Church Books, 1552-1981 — Malšice baptism register 1861-1887, entry for Josef Janovsky, baptised 26 Jan 1874, mother Marie
